# Elmish.Avalonia.Glue documentation

Immutable Elmish models flow to stable Avalonia DataContexts; AXAML TwoWay setters dispatch messages instead of mutating snapshots. Projection uses explicit CLR viewmodels, ElmView uses immutable F# view records and handwritten generated-shaped hosts. No custom AXAML binding model or generator is shipped.

## Task router

- Pick an adapter: /index.html#choose-the-adapter, /guides/projection.html, /guides/elmview.html
